bank.q: Consider the following statements about disqualification and elections:
s: Lily Thomas struck down the protection that let convicted legislators retain their seats pending appeal.
Public Interest Foundation created new grounds of disqualification for those facing charges.
N. P. Ponnuswami barred courts from intervening at intermediate stages of an election.
bank.e: Statements 1 and 3 are correct. Public Interest Foundation expressly declined to create new disqualification grounds, directing publicity of pending cases instead.

bank.q: Match List I (instrument) with List II (subject):
pairs: 1. Special Intensive Revision of electoral rolls
2. One-third reservation of Lok Sabha seats for women
4. Operationalising and sunset clause tied to delimitation
bank.e: Article 330A creates the reservation, 334A defers it, ADR v. ECI upheld SIR, and ADR v. UoI struck down electoral bonds.

bank.q: Which one of the following statements is NOT correct?
o: The Model Code of Conduct has no statutory backing
The 106th Amendment has not yet operated in any election
Political parties have complied with the CIC's 2013 RTI ruling
bank.e: Not one of the six national parties has complied — no public information officer appointed, no application answered.

bank.as: Delimitation has become the central obstacle to women's reservation.
bank.rs: Article 334A ties implementation to delimitation after the first Census following the Amendment, and attempts to expedite delimitation reopen the federal dispute over population-based seats.
bank.e: Both true and the Reason explains the Assertion — the defeat of the 131st Amendment Bill in 2026 illustrates the deadlock exactly.

bank.q: Consider the following statements about the Election Commission's independence:
s: Anoop Baranwal prescribed a selection committee including the Chief Justice of India.
The 2023 Act replaced the Chief Justice with a Union Cabinet Minister.
Removal proceedings against a Chief Election Commissioner have never been initiated.
bank.e: Statements 1 and 2 are correct. Removal proceedings were initiated for the first time in Indian history, though unsuccessfully.

bank.q: Which reform recurs across electoral finance, party regulation and roll maintenance alike?
bank.e: Disclosure and independent regulation — a political finance regulator, searchable deletion databases, and audited internal party elections all rest on the same principle.

bank.q: All of the following were part of the defeated 2026 package EXCEPT:
o: The CEC and Other ECs Act
bank.e: That Act was passed in 2023 and is separately under challenge in Jaya Thakur v. UoI.

bank.q: Arrange the following in correct chronological order:
bank.e: Lily Thomas (2013) → NOTA (2013, following PUCL) → the 106th Amendment (2023) → the electoral bonds judgment (February 2024).

bank.q: Consider the following statements about criminalisation of politics:
s: Candidates with criminal cases have three to four times higher win rates.
Around 66% of Bihar's MLAs have pending criminal cases.
Disqualification now applies from the framing of charges.
bank.e: Statements 1 and 2 are correct. Disqualification still requires conviction — debarment at the charge-framing stage remains a proposal requiring legislation.

bank.as: India's electoral reforms consistently favour post-facto remedies over preventive ones.
bank.rs: Election petitions, disqualification on conviction and judicial review of roll revisions all operate after the electoral harm has occurred.
bank.e: Both true and the Reason explains the Assertion — the reason pre-screening, statutory deadlines and expedited review recur across every reform list in this section.
